provider_contract.layout: N08: --request FILE --result FILE; schema_version=1, request_fingerprint, read_only=true, provider-owned layout data
provider_contract.collection: N02: --request FILE --result FILE; per-selection fields validated by validate_record; shared checks bind request_fingerprint
provider_contract.lifecycle: N03: required-lifecycle check includes all opt-in lifecycle cases; required skips fail
provider_contract.execution: Sequential; separately authorized execution only; shared checks run once per batch
provider_contract.configuration: native-configuration-v1 validates configuration without launching services; no legacy runner invocation

dependency-pins.semantics: Parse every nonblank noncomment requirement; resolve installed distribution in the selected interpreter; fail on missing distribution or version outside its specifier. Record each requirement and installed version; exit zero only when all match.
